name: Research handoff: November 6, revision 3
body:
Research handoff update, November 6, 2026, revision 3. The manuscript and polynomial remain Version 4: 4,973 total variables, degree four, and 72,925 nonzero monomials.

This update adds organized notes from the November 5 supplied research handoff and two collaborator PDFs. It records an exact replacement of their von Känel–Kret height input by the existing Version 4 five-contact proof, preserving exponent 24 and the thirteen-form prime pattern. It includes source hashes, the precise substitution, existing review qualifications, small reproducible algebra and constant checks, and a comparison distinguishing new ideas from previously supplied constructions.

Start with `current/research/2026-11-06-collaborator-notes/README.md` inside either ZIP. The supplied mathematical sources are unchanged. Their remaining parity/point-existence assertion is not established by this height substitution. The current arithmetic proof and finite polynomial certificate retain their separate review scopes. There is no new formalization-completion or improved-variable-count claim.

The full archive contains the new public snapshot, the selected research history and the unchanged November 4 revision-2 baseline. The current-only archive omits that baseline and supplies its URL and checksum. No raw supplied research ZIP, transcript, credentials or execution logs have been added.

`SHA256SUMS`, `BUILD_RECEIPT.json` and `handoff-plan.json` bind these archives to their exact snapshot. This research revision is separate from the Version 4 manuscript release and does not overwrite its assets or tag.

The project uses the collective agentic notes from Stefan Baranczuk, Gabe Conant, Sohail Farhangi, James Freitag, Elliot Glazer, Jenn Park, and Caroline Terry. Revision 3 adds this corrected credit to the November 6 research collection; the mathematics and polynomial are unchanged.

name: Version 3: the 9,625-variable quartic
body:
Version 3 of *Z is Diophantine in Q*, dated November 6, 2026, supplies an explicit integer quartic in 9,625 total variables, including one rational input and 9,624 rational witnesses. Its expansion has 82,476 nonzero monomials and maximum absolute coefficient 685783949153203534233601, strictly below 2^80.

The current files are `quartic_9625.tex`, `quartic_9625.pdf` and the `quartics/quartic-9625/` proof package. The source uses 29 full comparisons and eight beta-only comparisons, with H19, high40, beta12, anchor25 and scalar32. Three-mode and Jacobi proposals remain separate research.

The full handoff includes the exact public snapshot, selected project notes and the unchanged public November 4 revision-2 baseline ZIP. The current-only handoff supplies the same snapshot and notes with the baseline's URL and checksum. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`; `BUILD_RECEIPT.json` and the frozen plan identify the snapshot and payloads.

The baseline retains SHA-256 `827765f17087e1794c15770221a3a2d0fefed25839566a4a9bfb3b5aaa1ed42b`. The full ZIP is self-contained for its included collections, not all private history. Read `START_HERE.md`, `CURRENT_STATE.json` and `COVERAGE.md` after extraction.

Exact certificate checks establish rational projection equivalence to the pinned source and verify the complete integer expansion. They do not replace the arithmetic proof or upgrade its inherited theorem applications. The separate Lean formalization remains incomplete.

Version 3 is a collaboration using the collective agentic notes from Gabe Conant, Sohail Farhangi, James Freitag, Elliot Glazer, Jenn Park, Caroline Terry. The October 11 manuscript's provenance remains distinct.

body:

name: Version 2: the 12,504-variable quartic
body:
Version 2 of *Z is Diophantine in Q* includes an explicit degree-four integer
polynomial in 12,504 total variables, including one rational input and 12,503
rational witnesses. Its full expansion has 135,721 nonzero monomials and
maximum absolute coefficient 685783949153203534233601, strictly below 2^80.

The TeX and PDF are supplied separately. Two research handoffs accompany them:

- **Full handoff:** the exact public snapshot and selected mathematical notes,
  plus the complete unchanged public November 4 revision-2 archive.
- **Current-only handoff:** the same snapshot and selected notes, with the
  historical archive identified by its public URL and checksum.

The current snapshot includes the quartic coefficient table, certificate,
audited source, reproducibility scripts, verification receipts, proof
dependencies and review records. Read `START_HERE.md`, `CURRENT_STATE.json`,
and `COVERAGE.md` after extraction. The low-precision research experiments are
clearly marked unadopted and do not define the released source.

Check each download against `SHA256SUMS`. `BUILD_RECEIPT.json` and
`handoff-plan.json` identify the exact snapshot and payloads. The baseline
inside the full ZIP retains SHA-256
`827765f17087e1794c15770221a3a2d0fefed25839566a4a9bfb3b5aaa1ed42b`.
The full handoff is self-contained for its included collections; it is not
a publication of all private research history.

The certificate checks establish exact projection-preserving algebraic
equivalence to the pinned source and verify the full integer expansion.
They do not replace the manuscript's arithmetic argument or independent
human peer review. The Lean formalization remains incomplete.

Version 2 is a collaboration using the collective agentic notes from Gabe
Conant, Sohail Farhangi, James Freitag, Elliot Glazer, Jenn Park, Caroline
Terry.

name: Current paper and dated research handoff, updated November 5, 2026
body:
Updated manuscript, matching 141-page PDF, and complete refreshed research handoff.

This revision includes the later proof justifications and the height argument without von Känel–Kret. Four independent Astra reviews found no unresolved gap in that replacement within their stated scopes. Their final-text review reports are in the repository and the archive. The main theorem and numerical bounds are unchanged. The Lean formalization is incomplete; these reviews are not human peer review or formal verification.

The handoff preserves the original research archive and adds later drafts, audit feedback, sources and review records. It excludes conversations and credentials. Start with START_HERE.md, CURRENT_STATE.json and current/.

The TeX compiled without errors or unresolved references. Construction regeneration, finite checks and the unchanged Lean snapshot's source checks passed. SHA256SUMS in the repository records the exact three files. Earlier research versions are retained inside the handoff archive; this is the only current GitHub release.

### November 5 AI attribution update

The 11/5 TeX and PDF now name Opus 5.5 and credit auditing to Fable 5.1. The mathematical text is unchanged; the PDF remains 141 pages. The research handoff zip remains the dated snapshot preceding this attribution correction. Updated manuscript files correspond to commit `d18f8d5f5fa8a49675d98f655631de68f590d930`.

### November 5 source-application audit

The current manuscript is dated November 5, 2026. The TeX and 148-page PDF include the completed source-application audit repairs. The inventory records 82 scoped decisions, 147 citations and 443 anchored contexts, with retained internal premises. These reviews are not a formal verification of the main theorem. The November 4 handoff zip remains the dated research-history snapshot; new audit files and source requirements are in the repository. Current paper and inventory commit: `97cec7fdd757d9a8e4f468151a47a6d3610fb2f2`.

[Read the completed inventory](https://github.com/elliotglazer/diophantine-z-q/tree/main/docs/theorem-application-audit).
